description:
Job Description Summary 
As a Full Stack Development Engineer for our Science and Technology Organization, you’ll build software end to end – from responsive, user-facing web experiences through the APIs, distributed services, and data layers that power them. You’ll scope and lead complex technical projects, laying the groundwork for early-stage products to iterate and scale, while driving software engineering best practices and delivering high-quality software on tight schedules. The work will be part of, but not limited to, the projects that are part of the recently created Wisconsin Tech Hub.

At GE HealthCare, we are committed to bringing cloud-based solutions for our customers: all aspects of computing services across the cloud and edge – including servers, databases, storage, networking, analytics, software, intelligence are delivered over the Internet. Our Science & Technology organization is harnessing the power of technology to make healthcare more precise, more personalized, and more accessible for everyone. From driving the overall clinical research and patient-centric innovation strategy to delivering new digital and machine learning capabilities – we’re committed to leading digital transformation, improving outcomes for patients and providers, and creating a world where healthcare has no limits 
 
 
 Job Description 
 Roles/Responsibilities 
 Work with a cross functional team to create software products under approved architecture and under the roadmap set by the product management team 
 Take ownership of features end to end – from the user interface through backend services, APIs, and persistence – with high emphasis on quality, test-driven development, and sound software engineering practices 
 Build responsive, accessible user interfaces using modern JavaScript frameworks, partnering closely with UX to translate designs into production experiences 
 Design, implement, test, deploy and maintain innovative software solutions to transform service performance, durability, cost, and security 
 Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, automated test suites, and the monitoring and observability needed to operate the services you own 
 Participate in software design reviews, conduct peer code reviews, and provide input and feedback to other members of the development team 
 Use software engineering best practices to ensure a high standard of quality for all the team deliverables 
 Serve as the Product Security Representative for Tech Hub, ensuring adherence to Secure Development Lifecycle requirements and that security controls, evidence, and documentation are complete before each release 
 Coordinate security reviews, threat modeling, risk assessments, penetration testing, security scans, and SBOM generation, and track remediation of vulnerabilities, security findings, and compliance gaps 
 Partner with engineering teams on secure coding and dependency management practices, and track security metrics, remediation SLAs, and compliance status across components 
 Minimum Qualifications 
 Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related discipline 
 4+ years of professional software development experience across the stack including front end engineering and modern design principles 
 1+ year of experience with building scalable, distributed systems using a modern cloud framework such as AWS, Azure or GCP and containerized deployments (Docker, Kubernetes/OpenShift) 
 Strong experience with a modern front-end framework (e.g. Angular, React, Vue) and with JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS 
 Strong experience with Java, a modern Java microservice framework (Quarkus, Spring Boot), JPA (e.g. Hibernate) or an equivalent backend stack 
 Experience using AI tools to enhance engineering workflows, optimize compliance checks, or assist in documentation generation 
   
 Desired Qualifications 
 6+ years of professional software development experience 
 Master’s or PhD degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field 
 Experience with design/architecting large-scale distributed systems preferably using AWS technologies 
 Experience with both relational and NoSQL data stores, including schema design and query performance tuning 
 Previous experience with big data systems, analytics, containerized microservices, serverless functions, and event-driven architecture 
 Experience with infrastructure-as-code, GitLab CI/CD tooling, and supporting production software deployments 
 Experience building accessible (WCAG 2.x) and internationalized user interfaces 
 Previous experience working directly with end customers to assess needs, identify solutions, and constructively resolve disagreements 
 Experience creating, documenting, and communicating software architectures for complex products 
 Experience in Agile software development, including building, tracking, and communicating plans, with the ability to drive process improvements and compliance automation initiatives 
 Technical expertise across all deployment models on public cloud, and on-premises infrastructure 
 Excellent technical problem-solving skills and aptitude to learn new technologies and methodologies 
 Experience working in regulated or safety-critical software environments (healthcare, medical devices, pharmaceuticals, or similar) 
 Familiarity with design controls, traceability, audit readiness, and release governance 
 Experience with secure coding standards, static and dynamic application security testing (SAST/DAST), software composition analysis, and secrets management 
 Strong understanding of Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL) practices 
 Experience coordinating security reviews, threat modeling, vulnerability management, and compliance activities 
   
   
 Eligibility Requirements 
 GE HealthCare will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States for this opening. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. 
 This role is based in the state of Wisconsin at the Waukesha facility of GE HealthCare 
   
 We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership –always with unyielding integrity. 
 
 
We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.

 
 
 GE HealthCare offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE HealthCare is an  Equal Opportunity Employer . Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. 
 







 
 
 GE HealthCare will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable). 
 







 
 
 While GE HealthCare does not currently require U.S. employees to be vaccinated against COVID-19, some GE HealthCare customers have vaccination mandates that may apply to certain GE HealthCare employees.
 
 
 Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes
